verdict.rationale: Undermind exposes an official MCP server plus a ChatGPT app, letting users issue open-ended natural-language research goals ("deep literature review from an open-ended research goal") that the tool autonomously plans searches for, and it integrates into agentic clients like Cursor, Copilot, Claude, and VS Code. Community reports confirm real users interacting with it via natural queries and getting synthesized results, supporting genuine natural-language operation. missing for 10: no independent benchmark of NL command robustness/edge cases, and probes show no llms.txt/openapi docs corroborating broader NL API surface.
